body:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick thread to align on AcmeCo renewal. They want to move from 12m to 9m and pay via PO instead of CC. Pricing impact and signature flow need clarity.

jake_csm: FYI account health is fine, usage steady. Risk is procurement delay if we require new billing entity paperwork.

olivia_fin: If they shorten to 9 months at pro-rate, seat pricing math is straightforward but we need approval for the non-standard term. Est. invoice amount = $73,500 (9m).

kevin_legal: Need to confirm whether the existing MSA covers 9m amendments. If billing entity changes (US -> EU subsidiary) legal will need a simple addendum and a signature from authorized sig.

alex_procurement: From their side: procurement team prefers PO for audit. They requested vendor code and vendor address on the PO. Also asked if we accept electronic signature via DocuSign.

maria_cs: @alex_procurement can you paste the PO template when you have it? Also tagging @emma_enablement — onboarding sync for 9m term change? any changes to enablement schedule?

alex_procurement: attaching a small PO snippet here (they pasted in chat):
```
PO: ACME-PO-2026-445
Vendor: Redwood Inference Inc.
Amount: 73500
Term: 9 months
Billing entity: Redwood Inference Inc. (US)
```

emma_enablement: Enablement can compress to a two-week kickoff if seats are unchanged. We just need confirmation on seat count and whether they want the health-check workshop.

jake_csm: Seat count is steady at 75. They want the workshop. Plan: schedule workshop week after contract sign.

olivia_fin: Two operational notes: 1) If they submit PO we require net30 standard; 2) For EU billing entity we need VAT details — they must provide VAT ID or we'll invoice US entity.

kevin_legal: To speed legal, propose a one-page amendment: term = 9 months, pricing = pro-rated per attached calc, signature via DocuSign accepted. I'll draft and share for quick review.

maria_cs: Sounds good. Action items:
- kevin_legal: draft amendment and DocuSign envelope (ETA EOD)
- alex_procurement: confirm PO template includes vendor code and send PO by EOD next business day
- olivia_fin: prepare pro-rate invoice preview and payment terms note
- emma_enablement: hold two workshop slots next month, link will be shared once signed

alex_procurement: We may need a vendor code for the EU entity — can Redwood provide both US and EU vendor names/addresses on the invoice?

olivia_fin: We can emit invoice to either entity but legal needs to confirm entity mapping. If they want EU invoicing, we need their EU entity details (company name, VAT).

maria_cs: Customer asked about interim access while procurement processes PO. Can we allow 2-week provisional access on CC until PO clears?

jake_csm: We can enable provisional access but need a signed COT (commitment-to-pay) or similar. Prefer documented approval.

kevin_legal: We can add a short payment acknowledgment clause to the amendment allowing provisional provisioning subject to PO receipt within 14 days. I'll include language.

alex_procurement: They'll try to route PO quickly if we accept DocuSign + card fallback. I'll push for PO but will confirm fallback plan.

maria_cs: Great. I'll consolidate into a single email for the customer and copy finance/legal. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(automated) deploy-bot: Reminder — shared doc link created: https://redwood-inference.app/docs/amendments/acmeco-9m-draft

maria_cs: Updated timeline in doc. Will ping when amendment is ready for signatures.

alex_procurement: I'll aim to send the PO tomorrow morning.

olivia_fin: Received — will prep invoice once PO and entity confirmed.

kevin_legal: Draft uploaded, small edits left. ETA 6 hours.

maria_cs: Closing loop — followups tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
